_readme: THE file you edit after launch. Changes go live within minutes of saving on GitHub — no code changes, no Chrome Web Store re-review. Leave a value as "" (empty) to keep that feature switched off. See docs/0_LAUNCH_PLAN.md for when to fill each one in.

site._affiliate_note: The next five settings are only used on famillos.com list pages (registries and creator lists), where affiliate links are allowed. awinMerchants maps a shop domain to its Awin advertiser ID, for each advertiser that has approved you.
